extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Broker for Unreal Engine's built-in MCP server: token auth, execute default-deny, op log. Lab-only. Agents never touch Epic's unauthenticated editor MCP server directly: seahawk authenticates every call, curates downstream tools by class, forwards one settle at a time against the stateful editor session, and logs refusals. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Seahawk does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Seahawk

skills.description: Brokerage status, the downstream surface, and the append-only op log; every tools/call must carry the agent token, which the guard verifies and strips from the frame before forwarding (seahawk_status, seahawk_surface, seahawk_oplog).
skills.name: Broker guard and status

skills.description: List and describe the curated toolsets of Unreal Engine's built-in MCP server; every downstream tool is classified before it can be reached (list_toolsets, describe_toolset).
skills.name: Toolset curation

skills.description: Observe-class reads against the live Unreal editor through the broker, never raw access to Epic's unauthenticated server (seahawk_fetch).
skills.name: Editor observation

skills.description: Ground and act on the editor GUI through the broker (observe, ground, act_verified); execute-class actions are default-deny (seahawk_gui).
skills.name: GUI brokerage

skills.description: Acquire media assets into the estate under manifest, hash, and licence-evidence checks, with typed refusals for uncleared or mislabelled material (seahawk_acquire).
skills.name: Asset acquisition
